Title: Datetime Offset-Naive vs Offset-Aware Comparison TypeError
Root_Cause: SQLite returns naive datetimes while Python datetime.now(timezone.utc) produces tz-aware timestamps causing crash in session validation and robot heartbeat
Remediation_Applied: Normalized all datetimes via get_utc_now() and stripped tzinfo prior to delta comparisons

Title: Order Creation Emitted Null Task ID in Response Payload
Root_Cause: SQLAlchemy model default callable lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()) is not evaluated until session flush leaving Task.id as None in response dictionary
Remediation_Applied: Explicitly assigned str(uuid.uuid4()) and invoked db.flush() prior to populating items list

Title: FastAPI HTTPException Wrapper Obscuring Safe Error Envelope
Root_Cause: Route handler in operations.py caught WarehouseSecurityException and raised HTTPException with dict detail yielding {"detail": ...} instead of standardized {"error": ...}
Remediation_Applied: Removed unnecessary HTTPException wrap allowing exceptions to propagate cleanly to the global WarehouseSecurityException handler

Title: Static Sequence Number in Command Dispatch Caused Unique Constraint Failure
Root_Cause: TaskAssignmentService statically set sequence_number=1 on Command causing SQLite IntegrityError when dispatching subsequent tasks to the same robot
Remediation_Applied: Implemented dynamic monotonic sequence generation via func.max(Command.sequence_number) + 1 per robot_id

Title: Ambient Session Cookie Overrode Explicit Bearer Authorization Header
Root_Cause: FastAPI dependency get_current_user evaluated cookies before request headers causing TestClient cookie persistence from operator Alice to hijack customer Bob's requests
Remediation_Applied: Restructured authentication priority: explicit Authorization Bearer header evaluated first with ambient cookie fallback

Title: Unhandled Database IntegrityError on Concurrent Worker Flush
Root_Cause: Simultaneous thread assignment flushed command duplicate sequence to database before commit raising raw sqlite3.IntegrityError instead of HTTP 409 conflict
Remediation_Applied: Wrapped command insertion flush and transaction commit in try-except IntegrityError returning HTTP 409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT
